description: This file contains a series of automated tests for a Git-Perforce (git p4) integration, focusing on file encoding, line endings, symbolic links, and special file handling. It serves as a test script to verify behaviors and correctness of the git p4 implementation with various file formats and configurations.

methods.name: build_smush
methods.description: Creates scripts for transforming keyword expansions in text files to normalize or remove keywords like $Id$, $Header$, etc.

methods.name: build_gendouble
methods.description: Creates a Python script that generates an AppleDouble header structure with specific magic number and version, used to simulate or test AppleDouble file handling.
